suggestions.signal_name: Real M2 YoY (M2 deflated by CPI)
suggestions.observation: Nominal M2 YoY conflates the inflation and liquidity channels (H1 vs H1b). Real M2 growth isolates the liquidity impulse net of the inflation that drives the Fed-tightening headwind.
suggestions.rationale: Monetarist literature treats real balances as the transmission variable; deflating may sharpen the procyclical signal and resolve the level-vs-accel ambiguity.
suggestions.caveats: Adds a second revised series (CPI); both are revised, compounding vintage risk.
